ConflictSide.description: The side whose lines a file-level conflict holds.

description: One conflict record (doc 05 §11.2; WP-S1.17 D14, D17): rank 255, in the file of its target. A record-level conflict shares its target's ID and holds the conflicting members of each side; a file-level one (`kind` "file") holds the lines of the side that could not be merged.

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

base.description: The conflicting members at the merge base, as a partial object; `{}` without a base.

kind.description: The target's `$k`, or "file" for a file-level conflict.

lines.description: The lines of that side, verbatim.

ours.description: The conflicting members of this side as a partial object, or "deleted".

path.description: The project-relative path of the file, `/` separators.

theirs.description: The conflicting members of this side as a partial object, or "deleted".

title: conflict
